messages:
Priya K: Hey finance — saw a weird "EMT SURCHARGE" on my corporate card from HOTEL TOKYO SHINBASHI. Folio doesn't list it and I already had an approved room upgrade from @Ava R. Should I dispute or just file the expense?
Sam T: Share the txn details and reservation # please. If upgrade was pre-approved that's good — need the approval screenshot.
Priya K: TXN: JPY 18,250, post date 2026-11-03, auth 7A9XQ, descriptor HOTELTOKYO*EMT SURCHARGE, converted $128.73. I uploaded folio but it only shows room + tax.
Liam F: If it's a merchant fee (hotel added), we cover lodging when approved. If it's a DCC/bank conversion, Finance won't reimburse the markup. Need itemized folio to tell which.
Expenses Bot: Reminder — attach itemized folio and approval under category travel/tokyo; missing folio blocks auto-approval.
Ava R: I approved the upgrade on 2026-10-29 (DM screenshot attached). Priya, include that with the expense.
Priya K: Quick question: if folio doesn't show surcharge, do I open a dispute now with the card provider?
Sam T: Submit the expense first with note "possible DCC/EMT surcharge" and include all attachments. Finance Ops will review and can escalate to bank for dispute; disputes can take 2-6 weeks.
Liam F: Also ask the card provider whether DCC was applied at POS — sometimes they can reverse the markup.
Priya K: Filed expense EXP-3248 and attached folio + approval screenshot + receipt. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Expenses Bot: Expense EXP-3248 created, status: pending manual review.
